release_notes_md:
# v0.9.0 — Statistical analytics suite

**The dashboard now turns the camera's on-board analytics into trends, not just
live alerts.** This release adds a full statistical plane — people, queue,
heatmap, and vehicle counting — pulled directly from each camera and charted
over time, alongside per-zone dwell alerts. It is separate from (and additive
to) the real-time event plane.

---

### What's new

- **People counting** — per named line, today's In/Out plus an In/Out trend over
  a day (hourly) or week (daily). Disabled lines are hidden but still recorded;
  an explicit "Re-enable counting on camera" action is offered when a camera's
  counting engine is found switched off (never re-enabled automatically).

- **Queue management** — per-zone live occupancy vs capacity, congestion level,
  and an occupancy / busy-time trend chart. **Dwell alerts**: arm a zone to fire
  when it holds **≥ N people for ≥ M seconds** — the alert flows through the same
  notification pipeline as every other alert (toast, bell, log, email, webhook),
  highlights the zone card red while active, and drops a marker on the chart.

- **Heatmaps** — the latest density map per camera, pulled on demand from the
  camera so the dashboard is current without waiting on a scheduled upload.

- **Vehicle counting** — directional per-line vehicle crossings with the same
  today + day/week trend treatment as people counting.

- **Daily reports** — the camera's daily XLSX is stored as a downloadable
  artifact and cross-checked against the live poll counts (a reconciliation
  badge flags any drift); the report is never co-mingled into the charts.

All statistical cards auto-appear for any camera the system detects the relevant
engine on — no manual setup — and stay hidden until such a camera exists.

### Also in this release

- Dashboard card setup no longer pre-selects stale camera zones, and the older
  industry zone-role control was removed from the Zone Manager.
- Fixed a camera-side zone delete that was silently failing (stale analytics
  zones could pile up).

### Changed components

- **api** — statistical-ingest poller (people / queue / heatmap / vehicle
  engines), per-engine analytics endpoints, queue dwell-alert watcher, daily
  report artifact + reconciliation, zone-delete fix.
- **portal** — statistical dashboard cards (People, Queue, Heatmap, Vehicle)
  with trend charts, the queue dwell-alert config + highlight + chart markers,
  and report download/reconcile; dashboard setup + Zone Manager cleanups.
- **ftpingest** — stores the raw daily report artifact and fixes an all-zero
  report false-failure.
- ingest / dbwriter — no functional change (version-aligned).
